WITH spatial_with_projects AS (
  SELECT 
    sp.arcref,
    p.fundflux,
    CASE 
      WHEN sp.boxx IS NOT NULL AND sp.boxz IS NOT NULL AND sp.boxz != 0
      THEN sp.boxx / sp.boxz 
      ELSE NULL 
    END AS ratio
  FROM scanspatial sp
  INNER JOIN projects p ON sp.arcref = p.arcregistry
),
project_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    arcref,
    fundflux,
    AVG(ratio) AS project_ratio
  FROM spatial_with_projects
  WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY arcref, fundflux
),
funding_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    fundflux,
    AVG(project_ratio) AS funding_avg_ratio
  FROM project_ratios
  GROUP BY fundflux
),
final_results AS (
  SELECT 
    pr.arcref,
    pr.fundflux,
    pr.project_ratio,
    fa.funding_avg_ratio,
    pr.project_ratio - fa.funding_avg_ratio AS margin
  FROM project_ratios pr
  JOIN funding_averages fa ON pr.fundflux = fa.fundflux
)
SELECT 
  arcref,
  fundflux,
  project_ratio AS ratio,
  margin
FROM final_results
ORDER BY margin DESC NULLS LAST, arcref
LIMIT 10;
